description.zh_CN: 整合运动精锐小队，浮士德牺牲后由浮士德训练并带领，幻影弩手们从龙门撤回核心城向塔露拉汇报。
description.en_US: Elite squad of the Reunion Movement, trained and led by Faust. The Phantom Crossbowmen return to the Core City from Lungmen to report to Talulah.

description.zh_CN: 爱国者（博卓卡斯替）率领的游击队盾卫，在核心城战斗中守护爱国者。
description.en_US: Shieldguards of the guerrilla force led by Patriot (Patriot). They defended Patriot in the Core City battle.

description.zh_CN: 乌萨斯公爵，塔露拉的养父，以教育之名施加源石技艺的思维操控。凯尔希在07-01_end中向魏彦吾透露他是塔露拉的继承人。
description.en_US: Duke of Ursus, Talulah's adoptive father who imposed mental control through arts in the name of education. Kal'tsit reveals to Wei that he is Talulah's heir in 07-01_end.
